g.text: FT5316DME mutual-capacitance controller, 21 TX x 12 RX

g.desc: FT5316DME mutual-capacitance controller, 21 TX x 12 RX

g.desc: Sensor FPC connectors, decoupling, I2C pull-ups, reset hold

g.text: Touch front end (FT5316DME, same controller family as the original MUCA)

g.desc: Touch front end (FT5316DME, same controller family as the original MUCA)

g.text: - 21 TX x 12 RX on chip; J3 brings out TX1-TX10, J4 RX1-RX10 (10x10 target). TX11-TX21, RX11-RX12 not connected.

g.desc: - 21 TX x 12 RX on chip; J3 brings out TX1-TX10, J4 RX1-RX10 (10x10 target). TX11-TX21, RX11-RX12 not connected.

g.text: - J3/J4: 2.54 mm right-angle female sockets (0.64 mm square pins). Sensor tails carry Amphenol Clincher 66226 pin

g.desc: - J3/J4: 2.54 mm right-angle female sockets (0.64 mm square pins). Sensor tails carry Amphenol Clincher 66226 pin

g.text: connectors (e.g. 66226-037LF, 5 pos), plugged from pin 1. Route RX away from TX and keep RX short.

g.desc: connectors (e.g. 66226-037LF, 5 pos), plugged from pin 1. Route RX away from TX and keep RX short.

g.text: - VDDA and VDD3 on the ferrite-filtered +3.3VA rail; IOVCC on +3V3. VDD5 and VDDD are internal regulators: 1 uF each, close to the pins.

g.desc: - VDDA and VDD3 on the ferrite-filtered +3.3VA rail; IOVCC on +3V3. VDD5 and VDDD are internal regulators: 1 uF each, close to the pins.

g.text: - R16 holds RST low at power-up (datasheet: reset low before power-on); firmware releases it after the rails are stable.

g.desc: - R16 holds RST low at power-up (datasheet: reset low before power-on); firmware releases it after the rails are stable.

g.text: - I2C address 0x38, <= 400 kHz. Parts ship blank: flash MuCaFirmware.bin over I2C from the ESP32 before first use.

g.desc: - I2C address 0x38, <= 400 kHz. Parts ship blank: flash MuCaFirmware.bin over I2C from the ESP32 before first use.
